label: WhatsApp menu by keyword
info: Answers WhatsApp messages with the right text for 1, 2 or 3 (or the words hours, address, person). Anything else gets the menu.

name: START HERE: setup in 3 steps (select this note)
info:
**Setup in 3 steps** (once, about five minutes)

1. **Link your WhatsApp number.** In the [Turbo Notify dashboard](https://dashboard.turbonotify.com) create an account if you have none (it is free), then open **Numbers** and connect your WhatsApp number. First time? Follow the [step by step guide](https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/guides/quickstart/).
2. **Create an API key.** Open **API keys** and create one with the **AI agent (MCP)** template. Copy it, it is shown only once. This flow uses the scopes events:read and messages:send.
3. **Paste it here.** Double-click a whatsapp node of this flow, click the pencil next to **Account**, paste the key and press **Test**. It tells you whether the key works and whether your number is linked.

**About this flow.** The events node checks every 30 seconds. Edit the change nodes to write your own answers. Group messages are skipped. The event carries the start of the text (preview), which is enough for short keywords. A person who writes something else gets the menu once an hour, not after every line, and nobody gets more than 6 answers an hour. The first check after you deploy only remembers the newest message, so write to your number from another phone after the deploy and wait up to 30 seconds for the answer. Answers leave one every 10 seconds and never more than 60 an hour in all, so a busy day cannot use up your message allowance. The events node listens to message.received and message.replied: a person who swipes to reply to one of your messages arrives as message.replied.
